title: The Layer That Can Take the Power Away: Torque Limits, Heat Derating, a Link Watchdog, an Emergency Stop, and Why Off Is Not Always Safe

artifact.note: the safety layer of a quadruped, run every tick and outranking the controller: a limit on each joint's torque; a derating of the torque as a motor's temperature approaches its limit (full below 0.8 of it, falling to nothing at 1.0, and off beyond); a watchdog on the link (soft after a short silence, off after a long one); the emergency stop; the fall decision of 35-09; a choice among four modes (normal, derated, soft, off) by priority; and the rule that going off while the robot is standing is turned into going soft first (the legs give gently) and off only when it is down, since a robot switched off standing drops
